text: The project is directly integrated with 'The Big One' Earthquake Preparedness Program, ensuring that its assets are part of established mobilization plans. It features a strong commitment to operations and maintenance financing, with PHP 461.16 million allocated over five years. The project aligns with the Metro Manila Earthquake Contingency Plan and MMEIRS, enhancing strategic coherence. It also adheres to World Bank's Environmental and Social Framework, ensuring systematic risk management.

metadata.solution_name: Philippines Seismic Risk Reduction and Resilience Project (PSRRRP)
